en.register: 🆕 How to Register Rinfinity (Under TraderWatch IB) 1️⃣ Tap Register Rinfinity Now below (uses our official IB code wnzx). 2️⃣ Complete registration & identity verification (KYC). 3️⃣ Open an MT5 trading account (Standard / Raw based on your preference). 4️⃣ Fund your account & log in on MetaTrader 5. 5️⃣ Once done, tap ✅ I've Registered (Verify) and send your MT5 Account ID + Email here! Note: Starling handles your verification automatically.
en.transfer: 🔄 Already Have a Rinfinity Account? (Transfer IB) If you already have an existing Rinfinity account: 1️⃣ Contact Rinfinity official support (Live Chat or support email) to request an IB transfer. 2️⃣ Copy and send this message: Hi Rinfinity Support, please assign my account to IB partner code: wnzx (TraderWatch). My registered email: [your email]. Thank you. 3️⃣ Once confirmed by Rinfinity, tap ✅ Verify IB Account and submit your MT5 Account ID + Email here.
en.deposit_mt5: 💳 Deposit & MT5 Login Guide 1️⃣ Log in to your Rinfinity Client Portal. 2️⃣ Go to Deposit and choose your preferred local/payment method. 3️⃣ Copy your MT5 Account ID, Password, and Server from your Rinfinity dashboard or welcome email. 4️⃣ Open MetaTrader 5 → Settings → New Account → search the Rinfinity server → enter your ID & Password. Have a question about account types or leverage? Just type it here — Starling is online 24/7!
